events.verdict: Wade (MIA) goes to, not through, Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) space after crossing half-court.
Whiteside (MIA) establishes himself in a wide screening position in Dotson's (NYK) defensive path and delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced video] Hardaway Jr. (NYK) gets part of his hand underneath the ball then continues his dribble.
Winslow (MIA) maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made with Hardaway Jr. (NYK) near half-court.
Robinson (NYK) sets the pick on Winslow (MIA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Hezonja (NYK) makes marginal contact with Wade (MIA) during rebounding.
Wade (MIA) crosses half court in less than eight seconds.
Hezonja (NYK) reaches in and makes contact across Wade's (MIA) front after crossing half-court, affecting his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wade (MIA) lifts his established pivot foot before releasing his dribble.
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) has his hand on Wade's (MIA) opposite hip but slides it off during the inbound.
Trier (NYK) makes marginal contact with Wade (MIA) that does not affect his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Hezonja (NYK) receives the pass and takes more than two steps.
Richardson (MIA) makes marginal contact with Hezonja (NYK) that does not affect his SQBR.
Whiteside (MIA) makes marginal contact with Hezonja (NYK) after the release of his driving shot attempt.
Ellington (MIA) initiates some contact with Robinson (NYK) during rebounding but does not affect his ability to get to the loose ball.
Winslow (MIA) makes marginal body contact with Robinson (NYK) during his upward shooting motion.
Robinson (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball during rebounding and does not affect Whiteside's (MIA) ability to retrieve the ball.
Hezonja (NYK) makes marginal contact with Winslow's (MIA) arm, which does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Wade (MIA) slightly extends his off-arm against Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) side, but contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) legally contests Wade's (MIA) jump shot attempt.

The crew communicated with Replay Center official Gediminas Petraitis to determine who the ball went out of bounds off of. Initially, the ruling was a jump ball and, after review, the ruling on the court stood.
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) commits the take foul on Wade (MIA).
Winslow (MIA) maintains legal guarding position and absorbs contact from Trier (NYK).
Winslow (MIA) makes marginal contact with Trier's (NYK) front after his gather. Whiteside (MIA) cleanly blocks Trier's shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) commits the take foul on Richardson (MIA).
Hezonja (NYK) sets the screen on Ellington (MIA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Dotson (NYK) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Robinson (NYK) could be deemed to be in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Hezonja (NYK) commits the take foul on Ellington (MIA).
